versions.changelog: Fix brand link (was 404ing via trailing period in auto-linked listings)
Daily free limit: 2 idea batches (6 ideas) per day

- Initial release of LinkedIn Post Ideas Generator.
- Instantly turns any topic or article into 3 unique LinkedIn/X post ideas, each with a hook, thesis, outline, and named post template.
- Designed with strict provenance: never invents facts or citations—content is always based on input text or topic only.
- Free to use, no authentication or API key required (rate limited to 20/hour per IP).
- Built-in workflow tip: suggests using the companion AI post detector tool before publishing.
